description: Unified personal lifestyle intelligence dashboard that ties together domain-specific scenarios (nootropics, skincare, diet/nutrition, exercise, meditation/focus, socialization/mental health, sleep, learning, biomarkers) into a single analytics and automation layer. Designed for personal use with an automation-first philosophy: everything runs hands-off by default, but each domain can be deep-dived and customized. The dashboard defines the shared data model, cross-domain correlation engine, and integration patterns that all lifestyle scenarios build against.
name: lifestyle-dashboard
title: Lifestyle Dashboard
